name: std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::size, std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::length
intro: Returns the number of CharT elements in the string, i.e. std::distance(begin(), end()).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of CharT elements in the string.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: For std::string, the elements are bytes (objects of type char), which are not the same as characters if a multibyte encoding such as UTF-8 is used.

summary: Returns the number of CharT elements in the string, i.e. std::distance(begin(), end()).
